deepconvlstm.name: DeepConvLSTM
deepconvlstm.review: Four valid Conv64 layers, two peephole LSTM128 layers, final-step classifier and dropout .5. The custom optimizer retains Lasagne sqrt(accumulator+epsilon) RMSprop. Native channels/windows and the common scheduler differ from original experiments.

if_convtransformer.name: IF-ConvTransformer
if_convtransformer.review: Unchanged author phone and wearable model files. Physical gravity/gyro/body-acc adapters are explicit. UCI gravity is total-minus-body acceleration; other targets use window-local Butterworth separation. Wearable inputs retain author mixup/center loss; the original data loader is replaced.

unimts.name: UniMTS
unimts.review: Strictly loads the author IMU ST-GCN branch. Full fine-tuning with a new target classifier, source joint mappings, Fourier resampling and wrap padding. Native windows and training-only z-score differ from physical-unit paper preprocessing; PAMAP magnetometers are excluded.

limu_bert.name: LIMU-BERT
limu_bert.review: Original masked-pretraining model, mask operations and GRU-v2 classifier. Masked pretraining uses training windows only; the frozen encoder feeds 20-step chunks, with valid-length weighted chunk losses/probabilities. Native sequence/channel dimensions and full labels differ from the published low-label benchmark.

hart.name: HART
hart.review: Unchanged author HART model.py. UCI uses total_acc+body_gyro [6,7,8,3,4,5], matching the author loader. Other targets select one physical accelerometer/gyro pair. Common canonical splits/scaling/early stopping replace the paper protocol.

mobilehart.name: MobileHART
mobilehart.review: Unchanged author mobileHART_XS constructor, not a renamed HART surrogate. Physical six-channel inputs and UCI total acceleration are recorded. Canonical training settings and subject splits are adaptations.

ispl_inception.name: iSPLInception
ispl_inception.review: Unchanged author ispl_inception model: five inception blocks, F64, max kernel68, residuals, L2=.00593 and Adam AMSGrad. All native channels retained. Common data preparation, splits and early stopping replace author experiments.

gpt4ts.name: GPT4TS
gpt4ts.review: Author classification branch: six GPT-2 blocks, patch8/stride4 and original trainable layer-normalization/position/readout choices. Only hard-coded device selection and local asset resolution are patched; target data and training recipe are canonical adaptations.

calf.name: CALF
calf.review: Author classification branch with two GPT-2 branches, rank8 LoRA, PCA500 word basis and original cmLoss feature/output alignment. Supplies an omitted get_peft_model import. Canonical supervised training is distinct from every original paper protocol.

units.name: UniTS
units.review: Author x64 backbone/classification path and supervised pretrained shared weights. New dataset/task/category tokens are initialized for transfer. Source checkpoint pretraining exposure is not independently reconstructed; do not claim a clean from-scratch benchmark.

timellm.name: TimeLLM
timellm.review: Author-supported GPT-2 forecasting branch with an added linear HAR readout over16 predicted steps. Preserves source prompt/reprogramming/forecast operations. This is a classification task extension, not reproduction of the paper LLaMA forecasting results. Inference checkpoints fold a word-mapping constant and do not support optimizer-state resume.

imu2clip.name: IMU2CLIP
imu2clip.review: Author MW2StackRNNPooling encoder and linear Head. Lightning base is replaced only by nn.Module. Physical six-channel input is resampled/padded to1000 steps. Weights are from a public community distribution: strict key/shape/hash loading does not establish original pretraining provenance.

imugpt.name: IMUGPT
imugpt.review: Genuine author T2M-GPT→BVH→IMU simulation, cached activity descriptions and original percentile-transfer calibration fit only to target training windows. DeepConvLSTM is pretrained for5 synthetic epochs then fine-tuned. Synthetic sample count, prompts, hip mapping and downstream protocol are disclosed adaptations; no paid API generation.

sensorllm.name: SensorLLM
sensorllm.review: Original Stage1/Stage2 classes, Chronos quantizer and sequence-classification model. Independent MHEALTH trend/summary alignment replaces the unavailable author Stage1 checkpoint. LLaMA/Chronos stay frozen while projector/new tokens/head train. Native channel schemas and deterministic summaries are adaptations, not exact paper pretraining.

onehar.name: One Model to Fit Them All (oneHAR)
onehar.review: Author CDNet components with newly initialized trainable IMU projections/ViTs/BiGRUs, frozen HHAR LIMU-BERT and BERT text prototypes. Per-dataset cosine-CE training omits paper joint training, LLM synthesis, DQA/DPS/PDS, category contrast and domain adversarial objectives. Pooling is corrected to per-sample normalization; RealWorld capacity extends to7 sensors. Cached/uncached parity and batch independence are checked per fold.

onellm.name: OneLLM
onellm.review: Frozen author IMU/shared OneLLM weights; class-letter next-token scoring. Only IMU modality modules are instantiated, retaining used shared weights/QuickGELU and bottom-right causal attention. One seed42 split pass covers all subjects; it is not five supervised fits or reproduction of supervised table values.

hargpt.name: HARGPT
hargpt.review: Raw10Hz prompt/answer adapter with train-only examples, exact label parsing, caching and a persistent budget guard. Paid calls remain disabled by user request. Offline fixture outputs are not measured results.

bymyeyes.name: ByMyEyes
bymyeyes.review: Author visual-planning/plotting pipeline adapter, original label parsing and train-only normalization/examples. Interface/offline contract checks only; zero paid calls and no measured benchmark score.

mosaic.name: MOSAIC
mosaic.review: Paper results only; no executable MOSAIC implementation was completed or run in this suite. The user kept MOSAIC paused. This directory does not contain a surrogate labelled as MOSAIC.

robusthar.name: RobustHAR
robusthar.review: Historical five-dataset paper reimplementation, outside the current19-method display scope. Three masked branches, source-equation cross-normalized attention/fusion and frozen encoders are tested. Missing dimensions, mask choices, norm axes and cosine-distance interpretation remain explicit in ROBUSTHAR_AUDIT.md; this is not author code.

tinyhar.name: TinyHAR
tinyhar.review: Historical five-dataset suite, outside the current19-method scope. Unchanged author TinyHAR_Model F20 with attn/FC/lstm/tnaive choices; canonical data/splits/scheduler and target classes are adaptations.

attend_and_discriminate.name: Attend And Discriminate
attend_and_discriminate.review: Historical five-dataset suite, outside the current19-method scope. Author AttendDiscriminate, mixup and center loss retained; source PAMAP/OPPORTUNITY recipes are selected explicitly. Canonical data and validation early stopping replace paper experiments.

deepsense.name: DeepSense
deepsense.review: Historical five-dataset suite, outside the current19-method scope. Source-audited TF1→PyTorch port retains real/imag FFT layout, SAME fusion padding and reset-before GRU semantics. Canonical10-sample FFT blocks and BN estimators differ from author HHAR preprocessing; complete numerical/framework equivalence is not asserted.
